title: Agent Viewer signed audit checkpoint (v1)
description: A signed checkpoint as returned by GET /api/v1/audit/checkpoints (issue #387). The signed bytes are the UTF-8 encoding of "agent-viewer/checkpoint/v1\n" followed by the RFC 8785 (JCS) canonical JSON of `body`. `digest` is the lowercase hex SHA-256 of those bytes; `signature` is the base64 pure Ed25519 signature over them. The next checkpoint's body.prevCheckpointDigest equals this checkpoint's digest.

checkpointSeq.description: 1-based, contiguous position in the checkpoint chain.

headSeq.description: events.seq of the newest chained row covered.

headHash.description: events.hash of the row at headSeq.

chainedCount.description: Chained rows with seq <= headSeq when signed.

keyId.description: ed25519: + hex SHA-256 of the signing public key's SPKI DER encoding.

prevCheckpointDigest.description: Digest of checkpoint checkpointSeq - 1; null only when checkpointSeq is 1.
